title: Account number used from a new device at 2:14 am
description: Constructed demo booking on a real Olist account history (the takeover account from docs/demo_block_bookings): new login device, 18 kg express at 2:14 am, to a consignee shared with other accounts. Company and city names are demo display labels.
expected: held -> owner says NO -> blocked, account locked
say: Held bookings trigger a call to the real owner.

title: Regular shipper, first booking from a new Hosur warehouse
description: Constructed demo booking on a real Olist account history (433 days, the hard-negative seller): first booking from a new warehouse (new sender, new origin) by a new staff login. Company and city names are demo display labels.
expected: held -> owner says YES, new warehouse -> released with a first-scan check
say: Honest customers wait minutes, not hours.

verify_sim.detail_answer: Plot 14, SIPCOT Phase 2, Hosur. Our new warehouse.
verify_sim.change_reason: We opened a new warehouse in Hosur this week and gave a new staff login to the manager there.

title: Held booking, owner number changed 6 days ago
description: The curated reshipping-drop booking (real Olist row). The owner's phone number on file changed 6 days ago, so Tracd does not call: a fraudster who changed the number would confirm his own booking. Straight to the analyst queue.
expected: held -> no call (number changed < 30 days) -> analyst queue
say: We only call numbers unchanged for 30 days.
